blocks.content: Important National Schemes Applicable to Arunachal Pradesh
8.2 Important National Schemes Applicable to Arunachal Pradesh

items: PM Awas Yojana (Gramin) — housing for tribal and BPL families
MGNREGS — major employment programme; road construction and water conservation
PM Jan Dhan Yojana — financial inclusion; significant in remote tribal areas
Jal Jeevan Mission — piped water to all households by 2024
PM Kisan Samman Nidhi — income support for farmers
Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan — integrated school education programme
Digital India — internet and mobile connectivity expansion; BharatNet in AP
National Food Security Act (NFSA) — subsidised food grains through PDS
Tribal Sub-Plan / Tribal Area Sub-Plan — special allocations for tribal welfare

blocks.content: Arunachal Pradesh is among India's most strategically sensitive states due to its borders with China, Bhutan, and Myanmar. Several important defence-related developments have occurred:

items: Sela Tunnel: India's longest bi-lane tunnel connecting Tawang to the rest of India, opened in March 2024. Located at Sela Pass (4,170 m); enhances all-weather connectivity to Tawang.
Border Roads Organisation (BRO): Has constructed thousands of kilometres of strategic roads; operates major projects like Project Brahmank, Project Arunank, Project Vartak.
Advanced Landing Grounds (ALGs): India has revived and upgraded several ALGs across Arunachal — Mechuka, Tuting, Vijaynagar, Pasighat, Ziro, Walong, Aalo — for military logistics.
Eastern Command of Indian Army: Responsible for defence of eastern borders; HQ at Fort William, Kolkata.
Chinese infrastructure build-up: China has been constructing roads, rail, and model villages near the LAC, prompting India to accelerate development.

Vibrant Villages Programme (2023): Government of India programme specifically targeting border villages in AP, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Sikkim, and Ladakh to prevent migration and strengthen presence.
Identify flagship central schemes specifically extended to Arunachal Pradesh for general awareness questions.
Strategic and defence initiatives along North-East borders are high-frequency exam topics.
Tourism policies and sustainable development models in Arunachal Pradesh are crucial for state PCS exams.
Home Stay Scheme: Government promotes tribal home stays to boost rural tourism income
Ziro Festival of Music: Annual outdoor music festival at Ziro Valley; attracts national and international visitors
Tawang Festival: Multi-day cultural and tourism festival in Tawang highlighting Monpa culture
Orange Festival of Food and Music (Changlang): Promoted by state tourism
Tribal Circuit and Heritage Tourism: Developed under Swadesh Darshan scheme
River Rafting: Siang, Subansiri, Lohit, Kameng rivers promoted for white-water rafting
Bird Watching Tourism: Eagle Nest WLS, Namdapha, Pakke promoted for international birding
